$comment: How this SDK's source divides into layers, for the thinness audit (plan task 6.5). Every source file under this directory must be claimed by exactly one layer — the tool fails on one that is not, so a new file is a classification decision somebody makes on purpose rather than a line that quietly lands in whichever bucket flatters the claim. Paths are relative to this file. Budgets apply to the hand-written layers only: 'generated' is not a cost an SDK maintainer pays, and 'tests' is not part of the surface a user installs. Measure with `janus-sdk-gates thinness` from this directory, or `cargo run -p pact_janus_thinness` from the repository root, which measures every SDK side by side (staged plan S0.11).
name: pact-janus-typescript
